24	/**
25	 * @title Legion Fixed Price Sale
26	 * @author Legion
27	 * @notice Executes fixed-price sales of ERC20 tokens after Token Generation Event (TGE).
28	 * @dev Inherits from LegionAbstractSale and implements ILegionFixedPriceSale for fixed-price token sales with prefund
29	 * periods.
30	 */
31	contract LegionFixedPriceSale is LegionAbstractSale, ILegionFixedPriceSale {
32	    /// @dev Struct containing the fixed-price sale configuration
33	    FixedPriceSaleConfiguration private s_fixedPriceSaleConfig;
34	
35	    /// @notice Restricts interaction to when the prefund allocation period is not active.
36	    /// @dev Reverts if the current time is within the prefund allocation period.
37	    modifier whenNotPrefundAllocationPeriod() {
38	        _verifyNotPrefundAllocationPeriod();
39	        _;
40	    }
41	
42	    /// @inheritdoc ILegionFixedPriceSale
43	    function initialize(
44	        LegionSaleInitializationParams calldata saleInitParams,
45	        FixedPriceSaleInitializationParams calldata fixedPriceSaleInitParams
46	    )
47	        external
48	        initializer
49	    {
50	        // Verify if the sale initialization parameters are valid
51	        _verifyValidParams(fixedPriceSaleInitParams);
52	
53	        // Initialize and set the sale common parameters
54	        _setLegionSaleConfig(saleInitParams);
55	
56	        // Set the fixed price sale specific configuration
57	        s_fixedPriceSaleConfig.tokenPrice = fixedPriceSaleInitParams.tokenPrice;
58	
59	        // Calculate and set prefundStartTime and prefundEndTime
60	        s_fixedPriceSaleConfig.prefundStartTime = uint64(block.timestamp);
61	        s_fixedPriceSaleConfig.prefundEndTime =
62	            s_fixedPriceSaleConfig.prefundStartTime + fixedPriceSaleInitParams.prefundPeriodSeconds;
63	
64	        // Calculate and set startTime, endTime and refundEndTime
65	        s_saleConfig.startTime =
66	            s_fixedPriceSaleConfig.prefundEndTime + fixedPriceSaleInitParams.prefundAllocationPeriodSeconds;
67	        s_saleConfig.endTime = s_saleConfig.startTime + saleInitParams.salePeriodSeconds;
68	        s_saleConfig.refundEndTime = s_saleConfig.endTime + saleInitParams.refundPeriodSeconds;
69	    }
70	
71	    /// @inheritdoc ILegionFixedPriceSale
72	    function invest(
73	        uint256 amount,
74	        bytes calldata signature
75	    )
76	        external
77	        whenNotPaused
78	        whenNotPrefundAllocationPeriod
79	        whenSaleNotEnded
80	        whenSaleNotCanceled
81	    {
82	        // Check if the investor has already invested
83	        // If not, create a new investor position
84	        uint256 positionId = _getInvestorPositionId(msg.sender) == 0
85	            ? _createInvestorPosition(msg.sender)
86	            : s_investorPositionIds[msg.sender];
87	
88	        // Verify that the investor is allowed to invest capital
89	        _verifyInvestSignature(signature);
90	
91	        // Verify that the amount invested is more than the minimum required
92	        _verifyMinimumInvestAmount(amount);
93	
94	        // Verify that the investor has not refunded
95	        _verifyHasNotRefunded(positionId);
96	
97	        // Verify that the investor has not claimed excess capital
98	        _verifyHasNotClaimedExcess(positionId);
99	
100	        // Increment total capital invested from investors
101	        s_saleStatus.totalCapitalInvested += amount;
102	
103	        // Increment total invested capital for the investor
104	        s_investorPositions[positionId].investedCapital += amount;
105	
106	        // Flag if capital is invested during the prefund period
107	        bool isPrefund = _isPrefund();
108	
109	        // Emit CapitalInvested event
110	        emit CapitalInvested(amount, msg.sender, isPrefund, positionId);
111	
112	        // Transfer the invested capital to the contract
113	        SafeTransferLib.safeTransferFrom(s_addressConfig.bidToken, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
114	    }
115	
116	    /// @inheritdoc ILegionFixedPriceSale
117	    function publishSaleResults(
118	        bytes32 claimMerkleRoot,
119	        bytes32 acceptedMerkleRoot,
120	        uint256 tokensAllocated,
121	        uint8 askTokenDecimals
122	    )
123	        external
124	        onlyLegion
125	        whenNotPaused
126	        whenSaleNotCanceled
127	        whenRefundPeriodIsOver
128	    {
129	        // Verify that sale results are not already published
130	        _verifyCanPublishSaleResults();
131	
132	        // Set the merkle root for claiming tokens
133	        s_saleStatus.claimTokensMerkleRoot = claimMerkleRoot;
134	
135	        // Set the merkle root for accepted capital
136	        s_saleStatus.acceptedCapitalMerkleRoot = acceptedMerkleRoot;
137	
138	        // Set the total tokens to be allocated by the Project team
139	        s_saleStatus.totalTokensAllocated = tokensAllocated;
140	
141	        // Set the total capital raised to be withdrawn by the project
142	        s_saleStatus.totalCapitalRaised =
143	            (tokensAllocated * s_fixedPriceSaleConfig.tokenPrice) / (10 ** askTokenDecimals);
144	
145	        // Emit SaleResultsPublished event
146	        emit SaleResultsPublished(claimMerkleRoot, acceptedMerkleRoot, tokensAllocated);
147	    }
